hypotheses.statement: EDF field structure can organize repository-authored failure and success narratives into a common diagnostic representation.
hypotheses.boundary: Repository-authored historical and teaching cases under a shared research process. This does not establish explanatory validity or external generalization.

hypotheses.statement: System Context improves semantic scope agreement beyond the effect of adding matched headings.
hypotheses.boundary: No randomized System Context ablation or matched-heading control has been completed.

hypotheses.statement: Validation Protocol v1.1 improves cross-executor reproducibility.
hypotheses.boundary: No controlled v1.0 versus v1.1 comparison and no independent replication.

hypotheses.statement: EDF improves control-point quality relative to natural analysis.
hypotheses.boundary: Current evidence is narrative and not scored against a blinded baseline.

hypotheses.statement: EDF produces materially comparable semantic diagnoses under independent executor conditions.
hypotheses.boundary: No completed independent human or multi-model reproducibility study.

hypotheses.statement: EDF updates origins, confidence, and control points proportionally as evidence changes.
hypotheses.boundary: The longitudinal architecture exists, but LRC-001 has not produced completed controlled runs.

hypotheses.statement: Origin Network and Propagation are usefully distinct diagnostic constructs.
hypotheses.boundary: One direct ablation and repeated authored usage. Independent replication is absent.

hypotheses.statement: EDF adds semantic value beyond a matched neutral structured prompt.
hypotheses.boundary: This is the primary question for the next controlled multi-model benchmark.

hypotheses.statement: Recurring diagnostic topologies generalize across unseen systems.
hypotheses.boundary: Patterns were derived from selected cases and have not been coded on a held-out set.

hypotheses.statement: EDF-0 is fast and learnable enough for routine use.
hypotheses.boundary: No time-on-task, learning-curve, or independent usability study has been completed.
